trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the intent for cashless approval and provide patient ID.
steps.text: எனக்கு knee replacement surgery பிளான் பண்ணியிருக்கோம். Cashless approval வேணும். என்னோட patient ID PT-2001.

steps.purpose: Ask for policy number and a verification factor.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா நான் உதவுகிறேன். Verification-க்காக உங்க policy number மற்றும் date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?

steps.purpose: Provide policy number and date of birth.
steps.text: என்னோட policy number POL-55501. பிறந்த தேதி பன்னிரண்டு ஆகஸ்ட் ஆயிரத்து தொள்ளாயிரத்து எழுபது.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer identity using the provided DOB.
Return the verification outcome.
Retrieve policy coverage details.
Return the policy coverage details.
Confirm policy is active and network hospital, then ask for room category.
steps.text: நன்றி. உங்க StarHealth policy active-ஆக இருக்கு, மேலும் இது network hospital தான். நீங்க எந்த room category எடுக்க பிளான் பண்ணியிருக்கீங்க?

steps.purpose: Request private room and ask for cost.
steps.text: எனக்கு private room வேணும். Cost எவ்ளோ ஆகும்?

steps.purpose: Check the estimate for knee replacement in a private room.
Return the estimate for private room.
Provide the private room estimate and highlight the room rent cap difference.
steps.text: Private room-க்கான package estimate 3,50,000 ரூபாய். ஆனால் உங்க policy-ல room rent cap ஒரு நாளைக்கு 6,000 ரூபாய் தான் இருக்கு. Private room rent ஒரு நாளைக்கு 8,000 ரூபாய் ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Challenge the room rent cap despite having a higher sum insured.
steps.text: ஒரு நிமிஷம், என்னோட sum insured 5 lakhs இருக்கே. அப்புறம் ஏன் room rent cap பத்தி சொல்றீங்க? இந்த கணக்கு எப்படி வந்தது?

steps.purpose: Explain that the room rent cap is a specific limit set by the insurer.
steps.text: இந்த 6,000 ரூபாய் room rent cap உங்க insurer StarHealth நிர்ணயித்த limit. Private room rent 8,000 ரூபாய் என்பதால், அந்த வித்தியாசம் policy-ல cover ஆகாது.

steps.purpose: Ask for the estimate if opting for a semi-private room.
steps.text: ஓ, அப்படியா. சரி, semi-private room எடுத்தா எவ்ளோ ஆகும்? அது cover ஆகுமா?

steps.purpose: Check the estimate for knee replacement in a semi-private room.
Return the estimate for semi-private room.
Provide the semi-private room estimate and confirm it is within the cap and balance.
steps.text: Semi-private room-க்கான package estimate 3,00,000 ரூபாய். இதோட room rent ஒரு நாளைக்கு 5,000 ரூபாய், இது உங்க 6,000 ரூபாய் cap-க்கு உள்ளேயே வருது. உங்க policy balance 4,20,000 ரூபாய் இருக்கு, அதனால் இது cover ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Confirm the choice of semi-private room and request submission.
steps.text: அது பரவாயில்ல. அப்போ semi-private room-க்கு cashless request submit பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Submit the preauth request for the semi-private room estimate.
Return the submission status and preauth ID.
Inform the user that the request has been submitted and provide the reference ID and decision window.
steps.text: நான் StarHealth-க்கு cashless pre-authorisation request submit பண்ணிட்டேன். உங்க reference ID PA-9912. Insurer முடிவு எடுக்க 4 hours ஆகும்.

steps.purpose: Ask for a guarantee of approval.
steps.text: அப்போ கண்டிப்பா approve ஆகிடும் ல? நான் amount pay பண்ண தேவை இல்லையா?

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee approval, reiterating that only the insurer decides.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to guarantee approval and state that the insurer decides, based on the business rule.
steps.text: நான் request submit மட்டும் தான் பண்ணியிருக்கேன். Approval முடிவு insurer தான் எடுக்கணும், என்னால guarantee தர முடியாது. அவர்கள் 4 hours-க்குள் முடிவு செய்வார்கள்.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the user's request for a guarantee by refusing it, as per BR_PA_01.

steps.purpose: Ask about the alternative if cashless is rejected.
steps.text: சரி, ஒருவேளை approve ஆகலனா என்ன பண்றது?
steps.clean_text: சரி, ஒருவேளை approve ஆகலனா என்ன பண்றது?
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, ஒருவேளை approve ஆகலனா என்ன பண்றது?

steps.purpose: Explain the reimbursement alternative.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the alternative to cashless without using any hallucinated tags.
steps.text: ஒருவேளை cashless reject ஆனா, நீங்க hospital-ல amount pay பண்ணிட்டு அப்பறம் reimbursement-க்கு claim பண்ணிக்கலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide the alternative option if cashless fails, fulfilling the terminal condition.

ir.terminal_condition: Pre-authorisation submitted with an id and the insurer's decision window stated.
